usedFor: Signable holds documents sent for signing, and Todoist gets a follow-up task through “Create Task” after “Envelope Reject”.

bestTemplate.name: “Envelope Reject” in Signable, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: A rejected envelope needs a person, and the task carries a title and details for them.

watchOut: “Envelope Reject” runs only on rejection, so “Send Envelope” and “Add Contact” need their own templates.
